StatusACTIVE SOP
PurposeDefine how the founder uses daily dashboards, executive decision records, weekly review, monthly review, quarterly planning, and source records as one operating rhythm.
Protected boundaryCadence layers summarize and govern; they do not replace source records.
Founder standardNo review layer is decision-ready until the linked records are current enough to trust.

Operating ArchitectureLink

Cadence layerOperating roleFounder decision posturePrimary surface
Daily controlKeeps the business current across sales, operations, compliance, collections, cash, and founder decisions.Same-day awareness and routing.06_dashboard/01_executive/Daily-Founder-Dashboard.md
Weekly executive reviewTurns daily movement into judgment, priorities, and direction for the next cycle.Movement, stall points, risk, and follow-through.06_dashboard/14_weekly-executive-review/Weekly-Executive-Operating-Review.md
Monthly strategic reviewTurns weekly judgment into broader business posture, strategic trade-offs, and direction for the next month.Business quality, execution quality, trust behavior, cash pressure, and system discipline.06_dashboard/15_monthly-strategic-review/Monthly-Strategic-Business-Review.md
Quarterly planningTurns the strategic reading of the business into a 90-day commitment layer with targets, owners, and deliberate trade-offs.Commitment, not diagnosis.06_dashboard/22_quarterly-operating-plan/Quarterly-Operating-Plan.md
Source-record boundaryKeeps each dashboard honest by tying conclusions back to live records and evidence.Material or disputed conclusions must be sourced before they shape action.CRM, shipment, compliance, finance, communication, and archive records.

Daily Command RoutineLink

Daily moveSurfaceRequired use
Start the day06_dashboard/01_executive/Daily-Founder-Dashboard.mdReview active issues across sales, operations, compliance, collections, and founder decisions.
Structure decisions06_dashboard/13_founder-decisions/Executive-Decision-Board.mdCreate or update founder decisions when an approval, override, or exception needs structured follow-through.
Confirm source currencyLinked source recordsUpdate source records before any dashboard summary is treated as final.
Route unclear ownership06_dashboard/33_control-routing/Founder-Control-Routing-Matrix.mdUse whenever the owner layer of a cross-functional issue is not obvious.
Confirm decision readiness06_dashboard/34_control-integrity/Executive-Control-Integrity-and-Decision-Readiness-Review.mdUse whenever a founder call depends on multiple linked layers and the system must be current enough to trust.
Govern executable checks06_dashboard/40_executable-checks/Trust-Override-Executable-Check-Control-Board.mdUse when a live executable check is active, same-day critical, fragmented across task, gate, review, and archive layers, or already in containment mode.
Carry containment logic06_dashboard/25_scenario-response/Executive-Scenario-and-Contingency-Review.md and 06_dashboard/18_executive-risk-register/Executive-Risk-Register.mdUse after the executable-check board when a trust-linked live gate is in failure containment or founder rescue is still the hidden fallback.
Test operating habit06_dashboard/35_system-adoption/Operating-System-Adoption-and-Readiness-Board.mdUse monthly to confirm the system is becoming real team habit rather than remaining founder-forced structure.

Quarterly Commitment GateLink

Quarterly review conditionRequired standard
Planning surfaceUse 06_dashboard/22_quarterly-operating-plan/Quarterly-Operating-Plan.md once per quarter.
Readiness thresholdPull the quarterly plan only after the monthly strategic review, strategic counterparty trust review, initiative tracker, revenue forecast, capital allocation review, scenario response review, assumption review, plan variance review, KPI scorecard, executive risk register, cash forecast, concentration review, and supply resilience review are current enough to trust.
Commitment lensConfirm what must be true by quarter end, what quality thresholds must improve, what response and counterparty-trust thresholds must improve on strategic relationships, what live-gate or executable-check behavior must improve, what trade-offs the founder is willing to make, and who owns each cross-functional priority.
Initiative bridgeUse 06_dashboard/16_strategic-initiatives/Strategic-Initiative-Tracker.md for priorities that span multiple weeks or months.
Initiative activationOpen or update the tracker after monthly review clarifies the top cross-functional priorities for the next cycle.
Weekly initiative checkUse the weekly executive review to confirm whether those initiatives are moving, stalling, or requiring founder intervention.

Founder Output StandardsLink

Review layerRequired ending output
Weekly executive reviewA clear business posture statement; the top three founder priorities for next week; founder decisions that still need follow-through; the executable-check or closure-evidence gap that could still invalidate founder intent; and records that must be updated before the next cycle.
Monthly strategic reviewA clear business posture statement; the top three founder priorities for next month; strategic decisions that require follow-through; the trust or response pattern that could quietly weaken execution; the operating-system or executable-check behavior gap that could quietly weaken execution; and the main watchpoint for the next monthly cycle.
Quarterly operating planA clear 90-day posture statement; top quarter priorities with named owners; strategic trust or response commitments that should reduce friction on live business; live-gate discipline commitments that should reduce founder rescue by quarter end; accepted trade-offs; and milestones that prove whether the quarter is actually working.

Escalation And Source-Record RulesLink

TriggerRequired actionRequired reflection
Weekly review reveals unresolved cross-functional conflictDo not bury it in notes; open or update 06_dashboard/13_founder-decisions/Executive-Decision-Board.md, 06_dashboard/10_matter-control/Active-Matter-Control-Board.md, or the relevant source record.Reflect the issue in the next daily dashboard cycle.
Founder override is active under fragile or controlled trustConfirm override class, what still stays blocked, recheck date, and proof required to return to standard rules through 06_dashboard/32_exception-governance/Executive-Exceptions-and-Override-Review.md.Carry the same override meaning through decision, trust, matter, release, and archive layers.
Trust-linked founder override is moving toward releaseUse 06_dashboard/33_control-routing/Founder-Control-Routing-Matrix.md to force synchronized override meaning first, 06_dashboard/34_control-integrity/Executive-Control-Integrity-and-Decision-Readiness-Review.md second, and live functional gate third.Movement should not start until the linked records agree.
Live executable check is activeUse 06_dashboard/40_executable-checks/Trust-Override-Executable-Check-Control-Board.md to create one founder-ready operating answer across tasks, gates, evidence, and archive readiness.Closure proof must be recoverable before founder intent is treated as satisfied.
